title: Acme Robotics launches modular warehouse picking arm
summary: Demo item. Acme Robotics announced a modular picking arm aimed at mid-size logistics operators, with general availability planned next quarter.

title: Acme Robotics raises Series C funding to expand manufacturing
summary: Demo item. The company said the new funding round will be used to expand manufacturing capacity and hire field engineers.

title: Acme Robotics partners with Globex Cloud for fleet telemetry
summary: Demo item. The partnership integrates Acme robot telemetry into Globex Cloud's monitoring platform.

title: Acme Robotics issues voluntary safety recall for older gripper model
summary: Demo item. A firmware issue in a legacy gripper model prompted a voluntary recall; the company said no injuries were reported.

title: Acme Robotics appoints new chief technology officer
summary: Demo item. The new CTO previously led autonomy research at a large industrial automation firm.

title: Globex Cloud introduces managed AI inference service
summary: Demo item. The managed service offers GPU-backed inference endpoints with per-second billing.

title: Globex Cloud suffers multi-hour outage in EU region
summary: Demo item. A networking misconfiguration caused a multi-hour outage affecting storage and compute customers in one EU region.

title: Globex Cloud reports quarterly revenue growth of 31%
summary: Demo item. Quarterly earnings showed revenue growth driven by AI workloads, while margins narrowed due to data center spending.

title: Globex Cloud acquires data pipeline startup Dataflow Labs
summary: Demo item. The acquisition adds streaming ETL tools to Globex's analytics portfolio.

title: EU regulators open inquiry into Globex Cloud data residency practices
summary: Demo item. The inquiry focuses on whether customer data was replicated outside the EU without consent.

title: Initech AI releases open-weight language model for enterprise search
summary: Demo item. The model targets document search and is released under a permissive license.

title: Initech AI cuts 8% of staff in restructuring
summary: Demo item. The company said the layoffs affect sales and support teams as it refocuses on product development.

title: Researchers disclose prompt injection vulnerability in Initech AI assistant
summary: Demo item. Security researchers reported a prompt injection flaw; Initech AI said a patch has been deployed.

title: Initech AI models now available on Globex Cloud marketplace
summary: Demo item. The partnership makes Initech AI models deployable through Globex Cloud's managed inference service.
